lines: We'd finally reached the dining hall without being spotted by the demons.
It would've been obvious to anyone watching by this point, but the effects of the demon qi were beginning to show in Aina.
She seemed to be desperately enduring it while twisting about, her skin trembling.
(Dammit, that Aina, why's her breathing gotta be so sexy... I'm over here fighting hard not to get horny too, y'know.)
(ー...Huh!? What the hell am I thinking!?)
(Nevermind that, medicine first!! Finish the mission, then you can do the dirty stuff, slowly, and thoroughlyー)
I searched for the medicine while desperately maintaining the last strand of my reasoning that was about to snap.
We just have to drink that medicine... If Metier's intel is correct, it should be on the shelf in this roomーHere, is this it!?
I could see what appeared to be a medicine box inside the glass door.
So this meant that VIPs, who were more about squeezing out money rather than life force, could enjoy themselves to the fullest,
then use this to get rid of the demon qi and go home, allowing them to receive patronage for many years to come.
(Not that I'd ever come back again!)
Then, just when I'd opened the glass door...
Dammit! We were almost there, too...
An alarm rang throughout the mansion. And at that same timeー
Ehehe, I'm sure your workout got the demon qi spreading♪
And just in time to eat.
With the demons that had appeared one after the other, we were completely surrounded.
Even though the demon qi or whatever's doin' me in, I ain't livin' so soft that I'd lose to you chumps.
Wait, Aina. Do you hear something?
Like a motor sound... or something mechanical...
No sooner had that sound approached the dining hall thanー
It was a daring appearance, accompanied by mouthing its own sound effects. And what had appeared wasー
『Wahahahaha! Popping up when called, Succubus Brave Lilim-Muo: Kai is here!!』
That figure was certainly familiar. Though perhaps it would be better to say I couldn't forget it no matter how much I wanted to.
『Fuma!! I won't hand over the medicine!』
Aina was bewildered at the odd mech that had suddenly appeared. It was little wonder.
Lilim is riding in that thing. When Metier and I caught her before, she fought back with this...
Uh, that moronic Succubus from before?
『Who're you calling moronic, you in the pervtastic swimsuit!?』
But hey, didn't that get wrecked by Yukikaze's Lightning?
『You're a green one! You're as green as matcha, Fuma!』
『I had a friend fix it up for me after that, and it's better than ever now!』
『I'm not even afraid of lightning anymore!』
Now that she mentioned it, I had a feeling it was a little different from before.
(But what kind of circles does she run in that a friend made this?)
Whadda we do, Fuma? It might look amusing, but it don't seem like an enemy I can beat bare-handed.
Well, what she's riding might be pretty amazing, but... it's still Lilim in there after all.
『Enough with the talk, come and get it!』
『If you won't come at me, I'll go to you!!! I was promised to be released from slaving over shaved ice sales if I beat you guys!』
Lilim... or Lilim-Muo: Kai, rather, rushed at us, wielding some kind of harpoon or spear.
